title: UX-001 keyboard and accessibility probe

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given USER-A has Home visible with the Tile Options panel closed
2. When USER-A presses "Tab" repeatedly through the enabled controls inside the section with test ID "${MFE_APP_PREFIX_STYLE}_appBar" on the Home page
3. Then The retained focus trace contains every enabled header control once before workspace focus
4. And Each traced control has a visible focus indicator in the retained screenshots

annotations.description: Actual React shell. Controlled catalog, user identity, photo failures, and SystemJS tenant. Chromium only. Accessibility and layout outcomes are proposed probes; no approved conformance standard is inferred.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
